name: magniom-monorepo
description: Magniom — Connectome-Informed TMS Target Decision Support System

scripts.build: turbo run build && npm run build:cloudflare -w @magniom/web
scripts.lint: turbo run lint && npm run verify
scripts.verify: npm run verify:requirements && npm run verify:srs-spec && npm run verify:target-engine-spec && npm run verify:app-shell-spec && npm run verify:boundaries && npm run verify:static-rules
scripts.verify:stage1: npm run verify:boundaries && npm run verify:static-rules && npm run typecheck && npm run format:check
scripts.verify:stage8: npm run sbom:generate && npm run sbom:verify && npm run security:secrets && npm run security:probe
scripts.verify:stage9: npm run build && npm run release:manifest
scripts.verify:stage10: npm run release:affected-cases && npm run postdeploy:smoke
scripts.ci:pr: npm run verify:stage0 && npm run verify:stage1 && npm run verify:stage2 && npm run verify:stage3
scripts.ci:scientific: npm run verify:laterality && npm run verify:adversarial && npm run verify:kill-switch && npm run verify:stage5
scripts.ci:nightly: npm run ci:scientific && npm run verify:db:from-zero && npm run verify:v2-baseline && npm run verify:exit-criteria
scripts.ci:security: npm run sbom:generate && npm run sbom:verify && npm run security:secrets && npm run security:probe && npm run security:backup-drill
scripts.ci:measurements: npm run verify:measurement-spec && vitest run packages/modalities/ packages/measurement-core/ packages/measurement-testkit/
scripts.ci:validation: npm run verify:v2-baseline && npm run release:manifest-v2
scripts.ci:deploy:staging: npm run release:manifest-v2 && npm run verify:db:from-zero && npm run security:secrets && npm run postdeploy:smoke
scripts.ci:deploy:prod: npm run release:manifest-v2 && npm run verify:db:from-zero && npm run postdeploy:smoke
scripts.ci:postdeploy: npm run release:manifest-v2 && npm run postdeploy:smoke && npm run release:affected-cases
